lastCompletedStory.title: Render the marker/merge-watch projection and diagnostic section in `cam status` output

nextStoryContext: US-004 wired US-002's projected StatusReport markers/mergeWatch fields and US-003's report.diagnostic into runStatus's print path (src/commands/status.ts). Two new private render helpers, both defined right before runStatus: `renderMarkersSection(report)` prints a 'Markers' emitSectionHeading followed by one emitWarn(label, detail) row per present blocker/wedge/stall marker (shipStalled/planEscalated/planPreflightFailed/implementBlocked/postMergeStalled/sidecarStalled/gate) plus a merge-watch row (accent ● glyph, NOT emitWarn -- an open PR polling CI is in-progress work, not a blocker) when report.mergeWatch is set; it renders NOTHING (no heading) when zero markers AND no mergeWatch are present, keeping idle/progressing output sparse. `renderDiagnosticSection(diagnostic)` always prints a 'Diagnostic' section: emitOk (success glyph) for the 'none' condition, emitWarn (warning glyph) for every other condition, followed by an emitMutedHint('next: <suggestedCommand>') row. Both are called from TWO call sites in runStatus: right before the idle branch's `emitSectionHeading('Next')` (idle path returns early), and right before the operator-paused/paused-specific `if` block near the bottom of the non-idle path (both still run afterward, now preceded by the new sections). No new StatusReport/WhyNotMovingDiagnostic fields were added -- purely the print path. AC5 (glyph vocabulary vs. divider color) was manually verified against renderStateIndicator's existing glyph-to-semantic mapping (pending/active/warning/destructive), not machine-checked (reviewer-judgment oracle). src/commands/status.ts's file-size-budget.json ceiling was raised 913->1005 for this story's two new render functions and their two call sites.
